301-4247-5643.easyPrerequisites: You have had at least one Zombie enter the battlefield under your control this turn.
301-4247-5643.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Putrid Goblin.
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Putrid Goblin enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your cotnrol this turn.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability
Repeat.

1981-2415-5686-6634.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Al Bhed Salvagers and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Al Bhed Salvagers trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

413-6012--5--195.notablePrerequisites: At least one persist creature has a +1/+1 counter on it.
413-6012--5--195.description:
Activate Blasting Station by sacrificing the persist creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, its persist ability and Reluctant Role Model trigger.
Resolve Reluctant Role Model's ability, putting at least two +1/+1 counters onto the surviving persist creature due to the counter-increasing effect.
If that creature had a -1/-1 counter on it, remove that and one of the +1/+1 counters from it as a state-based action.
Resolve the persist ability from step 2, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2511-6972-7804.notablePrerequisites: The top card of your library is a nonland card.
2511-6972-7804.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Captain Kathryn Janeway.
When Captain Kathryn Janeway dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Captain Kathryn Janeway enters, it triggers, revealing the top card of your library, putting the card back on top of your library, and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Captain Kathryn Janeway.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

489-1090-6626-6867.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Restoration Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Restoration Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Restoration Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

1368-1753-6321-7763.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-1753-6321-7763.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-3129-3899-7730.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

2034-4484-4871-7396.notablePrerequisites: A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
2034-4484-4871-7396.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ebondeath, adding {C}{C}.
When Ebondeath dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {2}{B}{B}.
Quintorius, History Chaser triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-1308-3899-4552-7290.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Does Machines.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

2366-3430-5702-6965.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-3430-5702-6965.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

933-1887-7009.manaNeeded: {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
933-1887-7009.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Conjurer's Closet triggers, blinking Avatar Kuruk and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk with two lore counters on it due to Vorinclex.
The Legend of Kuruk's first and second chapter abilities trigger, causing you to scry 2, draw a card, scry 2 and draw another card.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting two lore counters on it. Its third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

1263-4050-6351.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion, adding {B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Teval triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2060-2919-3497-3525.description:
Activate Ezzaroot Channeler by tapping it, causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Activate Crystalline Crawler ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's ability by paying {U}, untapping Ezzaroot Channeler.
Repeat.

338-2741-4186.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-2741-4186.description:
Gain life.
Light of Promise triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Essence Warden triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1690-2364-2538-6556.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact card in hand that can be cast for {0} due to Temur Battlecrier.
1690-2364-2538-6556.description:
Activate Mana Vault by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast an artifact by paying {0}.
Jhoira triggers, causing each player to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind, with you returning Mana Vault to your hand.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast Mana Vault by paying {1}.
Jhoira triggers, causing each player to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind, with you returning the artifact cast in step 3 to your hand.
Repeat.
1690-2364-2538-6556.notes: You can use a historic creature to get infinite ETB and LTB triggers. If you do not use a creature, this combo will not produce those results.

3327-4613-5073-5508.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
3327-4613-5073-5508.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
When Dargo enters the battlefield, Railway Brawler triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Dargo.
Activate Dargo using Tinder Wall's ability by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.
Repeat.

198-3918-4038.manaNeeded: {1} if Trazyn doesn't have a charge counter on it
198-3918-4038.description:
Activate Trazyn using Empowered Autogenerator's ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding one mana of any color for each charge counter on it.
Activate Trazyn using Farmstead Gleaner's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Trazyn.
Repeat.

141-2292-6475.description:
Cast Reunion of the House by paying {5}{W}{W}.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Reunion of the House.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Reunion of the House, targeting Naru Meha and any other creature(s) as desired.
Resolve the copy of Reunion of the House, returning the targeted creatures from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1458-3139-5864.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 7 or greater.
You control a Bird, Rat, Otter and/or Frog that does not have summoning sickness.
1458-3139-5864.description:
Cast Banishing Knack by paying {U}, targeting a Bird, Rat, Otter and/or Frog you control that does not have summoning sickness.
Valley Floodcaller triggers, giving Birds, Otters, Frogs and Rats you control +1/+1 until end of turn and untapping them.
Resolve Banishing Knack.
Cast The Great Henge by paying {G}{G}.
Valley Floodcaller triggers, giving Birds, Otters, Frogs and Rats you control +1/+1 until end of turn and untapping them.
Activate The Great Henge by tapping it, adding {G}{G} and causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate the creature targeted by Banishing Knack by tapping it, returning The Great Henge from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 4.

1636-5686-6095.notablePrerequisites:
You have a Zombie creature card in your graveyard.
Creatures you control can tap to produce enough mana to cast the Zombie in your graveyard.
Zul Ashur does not have summoning sickness.
1636-5686-6095.description:
Activate Zul Ashur by tapping it, targeting a Zombie card in your graveyard.
Activate any number of creatures you control by tapping them, adding enough mana to cast the Zombie.
Cast the Zombie from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
When the Zombie enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the Zombie
Repeat.

575-897-997.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Branchsnap Lorian.
When Branchsnap Lorian dies, Yedora triggers, returning Branchsnap Lorian from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Activate Branchsnap Lorian by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Branchsnap Lorian's morph ability by paying {G}, turning it face up.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-2146-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Activate Harnfel by discarding a card, exiling the top two cards of your library and allowing you to cast them this turn.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat.

3809-4499-4685.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Prosperous Pirates.
Prosperous Pirates enters the battlefield, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding four mana of any color.
Repeat.

468-4221.description:
Cast Massacre Wurm by paying {3}{B}{B}{B}.
When Massacre Wurm enters, it's first ability triggers, giving all opposing creatures -2/-2 until end of turn.
All of your opponents' lands die as a state-based action due to having zero or less toughness, as they are creatures due to Living Plane.
When the lands die, Massacre Wurm's second ability triggers for each land that dies this way, causing each opponent to lose 2 life for each land that died under their control.

610-2655.notablePrerequisites:
You have cast your commander from your command zone this game.
An additional instant or sorcery in hand with the mana to cast it, or an opponent has cast an as of yet unresolved instant or sorcery spell.
610-2655.description:
Cast your additional instant or sorcery spell, or wait for an opponent to cast one.
Archmage Emeritus triggers, drawing you a card.
Cast Fury Storm targeting the instant or sorcery spell.
Archmage Emeritus triggers, drawing you a card.
Fury Storm triggers, copying itself for each time you have cast your commander from your command zone this game and choosing the original copy of Fury Storm as the target.
Archmage Emeritus triggers for each copy, drawing you a card each time.
Resolve a Fury Storm copy, copying Fury Storm and choosing the original Fury Storm as the target.
Archmage Emeritus triggers, drawing you a card.
Repeat from step 7.

618-3277-4377.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn.
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Izzet Chronarch with haste.
The token copy of Izzet Chronarch enters the battlefield, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.
